title: Categorical cancellation form of section projection coherence

source.place: Second identity, categorical cancellation after postcomposition by the inverse canonical comparison.

proof.text: Apply the section case of ringed projection/composition coherence to the closed diagonal and second projection, transport it through the fixed internal-module comparison, and evaluate on the regular coefficient. Postcompose by the inverse of pushSectionIso.

proof_origin.place: Categorical cancellation step of the second identity.

mathlib_searches.results: No exact concrete declaration; the generic categorical cancellation API is in Sheaf.CategoryTheory.SectionProjectionUnit.
The generic unit cancellation theorem matches the abstract step but requires concrete module comparison transport.

lean.statement:
theorem canonical_section_projection_core_coherence
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (M : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ (ProjectiveLine Y))) :
    ((ρ_ M).inv ≫
      (M ◁ ((singleUnitIso Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)).inv ≫
        (pushSectionIso Λ Y).hom.app (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)))) ≫
      projectionMap Λ (secondProjection Y) M
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (diagonalImmersion Y)).obj
          (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y))) ≫
      (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (secondProjection Y)).map
        (sectionTensorMap Λ (diagonalImmersion Y) (secondProjection Y)
          (pullSectionIso Λ Y (secondProjection Y)
            (by unfold secondProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_snd _))
          (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) (singleUnitIso Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) M)) ≫
      (pushSectionIso Λ Y).inv.app M = 𝟙 _
